name: Direct Summation of Wavelets
aliases: Direct wavelet summation on adaptive mesh
Wavelet coefficient summation during volumetric ray casting
definition: A volume rendering technique that evaluates the radiative transfer equation by directly summing wavelet coefficients during ray casting, rather than resampling data onto a uniform grid.
summary: Direct Summation of Wavelets is a volume rendering technique that evaluates the radiative transfer equation by directly summing wavelet coefficients during ray casting, avoiding the need to convert the wavelet-based grid into an unstructured mesh.
